review: clues: machine-written (Claude) in en, with sl translations, from inside the viewing station in its Lakeland look (the oak sill rail at the big window, the slate eave overhead, the coloured panes, the board with the fells and their names, St George's cross; the view: the long lake far below with its wooded island, the fells, a pike, the grey village round its battlemented church tower, the oak woods, the dale); clear and haze change with the day, so no clue says how far one can see; the sl translations keep to forms that don't give the word's gender away where they can; not reviewed by a native speaker

clues.en: It's made of stone.
It has big windows with coloured glass.
clues.sl: Ima velika okna z barvnim steklom.

clues.en: It stands on a rock above the lake.
We're in it now!
It's made of oak.
It's in front of us, at the window.
We lean on it and enjoy the view.
clues.sl: Naslonimo se na to in uživamo v razgledu.

clues.en: It's made of slate.
It's above us.
It keeps the rain off us.
The fells are drawn on it.
It has the names of the fells on it.
It tells you which fell is which.
clues.sl: Pove ti, kateri hrib je kateri.

clues.en: It stands on a post.
It has a hole for your eye.
It makes far things look close.
clues.sl: Daljne stvari so s tem videti blizu.

clues.en: It has lots of names in it.
Visitors write their names in it.
There's a stamp next to it.
It's tiny.
It has a wooden handle.
It leaves a picture on the paper.
It's made of wood.
We sit on it when we're tired.
clues.sl: Na tem sedimo, ko smo utrujeni.

clues.en: Old Wilf has a rest on it.
clues.sl: Stari Wilf se na tem spočije.

clues.en: They're made of stone.
There are a lot of steps.
They go down to the lake.
It's white, with a red cross.
clues.sl: Je bele barve, z rdečim križem.

clues.en: It's St George's.
It moves in the wind.
They're big and round, and they go on and on.
clues.sl: So velike in okrogle, in se vrstijo naprej in naprej.

clues.en: They're behind the lake.
Walkers and sheep go up them.
It has a pointed top.
It's among the fells.
In the Lakes it's called a pike.
clues.sl: V Lake Districtu se mu reče pike.

clues.en: It's long.
It's far below us.
There's a wooded island in it.
Boats go up and down it.
Its houses are grey stone.
clues.sl: Njene hiše so iz sivega kamna.

clues.en: There's a church with a square tower.
clues.sl: Tam je cerkev s štirioglatim stolpom.

clues.en: It's down below.
From up here it's as small as a toy.
clues.sl: Od tu gor je majhno kot igrača.

clues.en: In summer it's dark green.
It has lots of oak trees.
It's by the lake.
It's low, between the fells.
It has fields and walls in it.
clues.sl: V tem so polja in zidovi.

clues.en: It's down below.
